items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And Bob Hope was on the stage and when he took his bow and got through -- this is funny -- the boys in the band started to laugh... Bob Hope seat of his pants had a hole in them, and we laughed like mad.

ctx.x: Yes. And we had a guy on their as extra added attraction, and I think his name was one that you might recall -- Bob Hope.
